title: docs(adr): amend ADR-0084 and ADR-0146 D1 — Studio's four pillars become one left menu of six domain groups (objectstack#36891)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTuMGhLAZx29zwDrayDGZZF)_

Fixes #36891
Part of #36890

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；这次只改两份架构决定的文字，写明 Studio 以后不再分顶部四个分区，改成左侧一个可折叠的分组菜单（数据、界面、自动化、平台、访问、AI），界面本身要等专题后面的卡做完才变。
- 为什么做：属于「Studio 重构」专题，先把分组、叫法和每种元数据类型归哪一组写定，后面的开发卡照同一份文字做，不各自发明。
- 出错会怎样：后面做菜单和详情页的开发会照错的分组或地址去做；这次没有改代码，合并前可以直接改文字，合并后要再修订一次。
- 要你做什么：看下面英文部分里「起草、未裁决」的七条（最要紧的是跨包的环境目录放进「访问」组），不同意的指出是第几条。

## What changes

Docs only, two accepted records amended in place, plus the generated index. No code, no spec, no behaviour.

**`docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`**

- Status line gains a dated `Amended in place` entry; the title now names the menu and keeps the old words after "was:".
- A new section, "Amendment (2026-11-24)", holds the decision:
  - Studio is the development surface of one app. Its top-left control returns to the app and names the current package's app (decision 5). The landing page goes by its own card (decision 9).
  - One collapsible left menu of six groups, one per registered `domain`: 数据 Data (`data`), 界面 UI (`ui`), 自动化 Automation (`automation`), 平台 Platform (`system`), 访问 Access (`security`), AI (`ai`) (decision 11).
  - The rule: a type's group is its registered `domain`. The key is required on every registry entry, so no type is without a group.
  - The type-to-group table: all 32 registered types (7 + 7 + 2 + 7 + 6 + 3), enumerated at `origin/main` `151e8123` from the spec's default registry, which holds the same 32 names as the type enum.
  - Four entries that are not a type: the organization's own flows under Automation, the default sharing overview under Access, diagnostics under Platform (all decision 11), and the `~all` directory under Access (drafted, see below).
  - A table of what stands and what is replaced, row by row against the 2026-07-01 text.
- The sentences the amendment replaces are struck or marked where they stand (TL;DR 1, 2, 5, 6; the diagram; the pillar table; Settings; two principles; one consequence; the alternatives).

**`docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md`**

- Status line gains a dated `Amended in place` entry.
- D1: the two sentences that kept the pillars and sent a pillar type to its pillar are marked as replaced. A dated block follows the decision:
  - the "All metadata" area is Studio's only entry;
  - an item fills the content pane, the menu stays and collapses;
  - one address per item, `/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/TYPE/NAME`; the object, the flow and the permission set open their designers there; pillar addresses redirect;
  - × , ‹ › and ⌘K change item, with no switcher and no "open in app" button (decision 7);
  - the ‹ › order is the list's, carried in the item's address, name order without a list context (decision 10);
  - the leave guard asks on every departure except the browser's Back (decision 12), anchored to the console's unsaved-edits seam;
  - the item tools are tabs, `?review=1` kept (decisions 8, 4);
  - one save model (decisions 1, 14);
  - a dashboard or a report opens in an app's own edit state, by the three-step rule, with "from Studio" in the address (decisions 3, 6, 15);
  - "New" on the two lists (decision 13), with how it stands beside the #36359 rule and the #36692 ruling that PR #36848 landed;
  - a table that says where each of the fifteen decisions is written.
- D2, D3, D4, D8, D11 and the Consequences each carry a dated reading of their pillar or landing wording. No rule of those decisions moves.
- Three new merge questions (13 to 15), a Rollout paragraph naming the epic's cards, and a Refs entry.

**`docs/adr/README.md`** is regenerated by the index script: one row changes (ADR-0084's title and status cell).

**Drafted, not ruled.** Each is a numbered item in its record, so an objection can name it.

1. ADR-0084 item 1: **the `~all` cross-package environment directory is entered from the 访问 Access group.** Decision 11 places the other three package-less entries and is silent on this one. The leg's directory lists four types, all registered `security`, and decision 11 puts every other such entry in the group of what it holds. Not taken: an entry of its own outside the six groups.
2. ADR-0084 item 2: **the Settings area (General and Advanced) is not a menu group.** Its types are found by the rule like every other type: `app` under UI, `hook` and `mapping` under Data, `datasource` under Platform.
3. ADR-0084 item 3: **the order of the six groups and their English names** (Data, UI, Automation, Platform, Access, AI). Decision 11 lists them in that order and names them in Chinese.
4. ADR-0084 item 4: **the record's title is reworded.** Number and file name do not move.
5. ADR-0146 merge question 13: **a pillar address keeps redirecting after the pillar routes are deleted.** From the epic's plan, not from a ruling.
6. ADR-0146 merge question 14: **the readings of the earlier wording** in D2, D3, D4, D8, D11 and the Consequences.
7. ADR-0146 merge question 15: **the page for D3's "n customized, m switched off" line is left unnamed.** Decision 9 removes the landing page and names no successor. This is a flag, not a choice: a home in Setup would reverse D3's last clause and needs its own ruling on #36908.

## Tests

No package is touched, so there is no build closure and no package test or typecheck to run. No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour. No dogfood battery: the title carries no `!` and the claim has no narrowing arm.

The gates that read the changed files were derived from the tree, run on head `e9ba427a9`, and reconciled. The readings are under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

**Card acceptance, item by item**

- "ADR text matches the epic's decisions": the fifteen decisions are written or placed by the table at the end of ADR-0146 D1's amendment; decisions 2 and 4's open halves are named with the cards that own them.
- "The table covers every metadata type, none without a group": 32 of 32. The rule (group = registered `domain`) makes this hold for a type registered later too.
- Card item 5 (a note on #36513) is a GitHub comment and is not made by this pull request. The suggested text is in the dev report for the seat to post.

**First files to read, by risk**

1. ADR-0146, the block "Amended 2026-11-24" at the end of D1. Risk hunk: the two bullets on dashboards and reports, where decision 13 is read together with the #36359 rule and the #36692 ruling.
2. ADR-0084, "Written here where the rulings were silent", items 1 and 2: the `~all` placement and the Settings area.
3. ADR-0084, the "Type → group" table and the three readings under it (`datasource`, `field`, `action`).

**Two-minute verification**

Run `grep -o "domain: '[a-z]*'" packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts | sort | uniq -c` on the branch. Expected: `3 ai`, `2 automation`, `7 data`, `6 security`, `7 system`, `7 ui`, which is the Count column of the table, 32 in all.

**How #36502 is described.** The Interfaces pillar's retirement (PR #36884, open and unmerged when this was written) is named as its own card, which this amendment neither waits for nor repeats. The text reads the same whichever lands first.

**Anchors.** New code citations are symbol anchors on things the decisions keep: three in the spec's registry module and two in the console's unsaved-edits module. Code that the epic deletes is named by bare identifier only, so a later code pull request is not forced to edit `docs/adr/**`. No line anchors.

**Noted, not filed** (outside this card; each has a carrier)

- Other records and docs still describe the pillar shell: ADR-0086 and ADR-0130 (one sentence each), `ui/docs/adr/0056-permission-editing-studio.md`, `docs/design/builder-ui.md`. Carrier: #36910, the epic's docs sweep.
- Decision 11 names two groups 平台 and 访问, while today's domain dictionary draws `system` as 系统 and `security` as 安全, and the menu card says to take group names from that dictionary. Carrier: #36899.
- Decision 5 does not say what the top-left control names when the current package publishes no app, or where it returns when the remembered page belongs to another app. Carrier: #36899.
- D3 says "Setup carries nothing per package"; one of the two homes #36908 may propose for the customization counts is Setup's package detail. Carrier: #36908.
- The `os` stats grouping in the CLI is an ADR-0084 consumer and does not follow the six domains. Not ruled on here. Carrier: none.

**Changeset.** None: `docs/adr/**` ships in no package. `skip-changeset` is declared with the pull request.
